metadata.description: Imperial German Navy Ranks, Awards, and WWI Historical Eras (1914-1918)

awards.name: Iron Cross 2nd Class
awards.description: Awarded for completing your first war patrol in the Atlantic.

awards.name: Iron Cross 1st Class
awards.description: Awarded for sinking 25,000 GRT of enemy shipping.

awards.name: Royal House Order of Hohenzollern
awards.description: Awarded for sustained commerce raiding excellence (75,000 GRT).

awards.name: Pour le Mérite (Blue Max)
awards.description: The Kingdom of Prussia's highest military order, awarded to top U-boat aces.

eras.name: Outbreak & Cruiser Rules
eras.briefing: Strictly adhere to Prize Rules. Do not sink neutral vessels without boarding and inspection.

eras.name: First Submarine Blockade
eras.briefing: Waters around Great Britain are declared a War Zone. Beware of armed merchantmen and diplomatic incidents.

eras.name: The Sussex Pledge Restrictions
eras.briefing: High Command has suspended unrestricted attacks following diplomatic pressure. Expect Q-Ship decoys.

eras.name: Unrestricted Submarine Warfare
eras.briefing: All shipping bound for Allied ports may be engaged on sight. Allied escorts are organizing into guarded convoys.

eras.name: The Convoy Gauntlet
eras.briefing: Heavy destroyer escorts, hydrophones, and depth charges guard every major lane. Strike swiftly and dive deep.
